{{recipesummary|category=Curry recipes|servings=4|time=2 hours|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Burma|Cuisine of Burma]] | [[Cookbook:Meat|Meat]] | [[Cookbook:Curry|Curry]]

'''Burmese pork curry''' is a light, flavoursome pork dish.

== Ingredients ==

* 8 dried red [[Cookbook:Chiles|chillis]]
* 2.5 [[Cookbook:cm|cm]] fresh root [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]], crushed
* [[Cookbook:Lemongrass|Lemongrass]] stalks, finely [[Cookbook:chopping|chopped]]
* 15 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]] (1 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tbsp]]) fresh [[Cookbook:Galangal|galangal]], chopped
* 15 ml (1 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Shrimp paste|shrimp paste]]
* 30 ml (2 tbsp) fine [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 675 [[Cookbook:gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] into chunks
* 600 ml (2½ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]]) water
* 10 ml (2 [[Cookbook:teaspoon|tsp]]) ground [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]
* 5 ml (1 tsp) dark [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 200 [[Cookbook:gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Green Bean|French (green) beans]]
* 5 ml (1 tsp) brown sugar
* 45 ml (3 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Tamarind|tamarind]] juice or 5 ml (1 tsp) tamarind pulp concentrate
* 15 ml (1 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]], finely chopped
* 15 ml (1 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Fish Sauce|fish sauce]]
* Fresh red chillis, to [[Cookbook:garnish|garnish]]

== Procedure ==

# Soak the dried chilli in warm water for 20 minutes.
# Crush the ginger, chilli, lemongrass, and galangal in a [[Cookbook:mortar and pestle|mortar and pestle]] until they form a coarse paste.
# Add the shrimp paste and fine sugar, and continue grinding to a dark grainy paste.
# Place the pork in a [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]] or large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium heat, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Stirring|stir]] in the curry paste until the meat is well coated.
# Cook the pork over a low heat, stirring occasionally, until the meat changes colour and [[Cookbook:rendering|renders]] some of its fat, and the curry has started to release its aroma.
# Stir in the turmeric, water, and soy sauce, then [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] gently, uncovered, for 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
# [[Cookbook:steaming|Steam]] the beans separately for about 10 minutes.
# Stir the sugar, tamarind, garlic, shallots, and fish sauce into the meat until the sugar and tamarind are dissolved.
# [[Cookbook:garnish|Garnish]] with the fresh chillis and steamed beans, and serve immediately.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The pork can have some of its fat trimmed, but should have some remaining to [[Cookbook:Rendering|render]] into the sauce as it cooks.
* Instead of galangal, additional root ginger can be used.
